name: Football Scouting — Eight Weeks
goal: Build a football scouting workspace for three developers in eight weeks.
desired_outcome: Profiles, reports, search, comparison, authentication, tests, and deployment without inventing a live-data provider.

clarifications.question: Which licensed live-data provider is available?
clarifications.answer: None; use curated fixture data only.

risk: Live-data integration remains excluded until a licensed provider is confirmed.
warning: Do not invent provider capabilities or credentials.
